subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should OpenClaw accept this opt-in `agents.*.iterationBudget` config surface plus the `onBeforeToolCallingRound` and `supportsIterationBudget` harness contract as the permanent loop-budget API?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but the PR creates user-facing config and plugin/harness API semantics that automation should not finalize without maintainer product intent.

options.title: Approve Contract And Refresh
options.body: Approve the current config/API semantics, rebase the conflicting branch, and require exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow Or Rename First
options.body: Change the keys, defaults, budget unit, summary behavior, or unsupported-harness policy before release if maintainers do not want this to become the shipped contract.

options.title: Pause Behind Canonical Issue
options.body: Keep the PR open but unmerged while maintainers settle the broader maxTurns/maxToolCalls direction in the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Approve Contract And Refresh
recommendation.body: Approve the current config/API semantics, rebase the conflicting branch, and require exact-head proof before merge.
